title: Herb & Mushroom Seasoning
description: Homemade approximation of the HelloFresh AU sachet. Uses the Garlic & Herb Seasoning as a base plus ground porcini. One batch replaces one sachet.

steps.text: Blitz the dried porcini to a powder in a spice grinder.
Mix with the remaining ingredients. Use the whole batch wherever the recipe calls for 1 sachet.
